question: What percentage of the MBS fee does Medibank Essentials OSHC pay for GP consultations?
reference_answer: Medibank Essentials OSHC pays 100% of the MBS fee for GP consultations.

question: What percentage of the MBS fee does Medibank pay for out-of-hospital specialist services?
reference_answer: Medibank pays 85% of the MBS fee for eligible out-of-hospital specialist services.

question: How much can Medibank pay per eligible prescription medicine item?
reference_answer: Medibank pays up to $70 per eligible prescription medicine item after the member contribution.

question: How long is the Medibank waiting period for pre-existing conditions?
reference_answer: A 12-month waiting period may apply for pre-existing conditions under Medibank Essentials OSHC.

question: Does Medibank cover emergency ambulance services?
reference_answer: Yes. Medibank Essentials OSHC pays 100% towards unlimited eligible emergency ambulance services Australia-wide.

question: How long is the Bupa OSHC waiting period for pre-existing conditions?
reference_answer: Bupa OSHC has a 12-month waiting period for pre-existing conditions, excluding ailments or illnesses of a psychiatric nature.

question: Does Bupa OSHC cover cosmetic treatment that is not medically necessary?
reference_answer: No. Cosmetic treatment or services that are not medically necessary are excluded.

question: Does Bupa OSHC cover assisted reproductive services?
reference_answer: No. Assisted reproductive services are listed as an exclusion under the Bupa OSHC section.

question: What MBS benefit does Bupa OSHC provide for inpatient medical services?
reference_answer: Bupa OSHC provides up to 100% of the MBS fee for inpatient medical services.

question: Is there a waiting period for emergency ambulance under Bupa Overseas Student Health Cover?
reference_answer: No. Bupa Overseas Student Health Cover lists no waiting period for eligible emergency ambulance including on-the-spot treatment.

question: If my Medibank specialist charges more than the benefit paid, could I still have an out-of-pocket cost?
reference_answer: Yes. You may have an out-of-pocket cost if the provider charges more than the benefit Medibank pays.

question: Would a Medibank direct billing GP always guarantee that I pay nothing upfront?
reference_answer: No. Direct billing can reduce or eliminate upfront payment, but an out-of-pocket expense may still apply depending on the provider.

question: If I need an X-ray outside hospital with Medibank OSHC, is the full provider charge necessarily covered?
reference_answer: No. Eligible out-of-hospital X-rays receive 85% of the MBS fee, so the full provider charge is not necessarily covered.

question: If a Bupa OSHC member needs cosmetic treatment purely for appearance, should they expect a benefit?
reference_answer: No. Cosmetic treatment that is not medically necessary is excluded under the Bupa OSHC section.

question: Can a Bupa OSHC member assume every hospital service is fully covered?
reference_answer: No. The policy distinguishes covered, minimum-benefit and excluded services, so not every hospital service receives full benefits.
